Title: A Flask app appears to be run with debug=True, which exposes the Werkzeug debugger and allows the execution of arbitrary code. (Merged: Bandit, Semgrep)
Remediation: Set debug=False in app.run(); disable Werkzeug interactive debugger in production.

Title: Use of weak MD5 hash for security. Consider usedforsecurity=False (Merged: Bandit, Semgrep)
Remediation: Switch to scrypt/Argon2id; verify legacy MD5 only on first login to migrate password.

Title: Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens
Remediation: Generate and embed CSRF tokens in all POST forms; validate on /login, /apply, and /leave/decide.

Title: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
Remediation: Set a strict Content-Security-Policy header uniformly across all routes via @app.after_request.

Title: Missing Anti-clickjacking Header
Remediation: Send 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' and 'frame-ancestors: none' on all HTTP responses.
